description: Fork only (see FORK.md): enforce the feature loop when the repo (or its main worktree) has .scratch/gates.json without status closed. PreToolUse on Bash gates git commit (slop in the staged lines), git push and PR creation (build-phase gates; pushes to the base branch refused) and gh pr merge or a GraphQL mergePullRequest (match-head-commit, merge-phase gates, green CI on that sha, HEAD equal to that sha); fails closed while a loop is active. Stop refuses to end a turn while a stage is running. PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure (every tool) and UserPromptExpansion keep the signed stage log in .scratch/.loop/ (Skill and Agent calls) and record source changes made before the planning skills ran; gate G9 reads it, and the push and merge hooks make G9 mandatory. SessionStart makes the log key and summarizes where the loop stands. fork.9: the same PostToolUse hook keeps .scratch/timeline.md and prints one systemMessage line per event that matters (ESCALATION: for the loud ones); PostToolUse on ExitPlanMode hands the approved plan to the codex plan review and stop 2 (no implementing); UserPromptSubmit records the owner's `approve acceptance|plan|pr` as signed approvals. fork.9: PostToolUse prints one line to the owner per step and keeps .scratch/timeline.md; ExitPlanMode hands off to the codex plan review; UserPromptSubmit signs the owner's approve acceptance/plan/pr; PR creation (gh, REST, GraphQL, MCP) needs the pr phase green and the owner's approve pr for HEAD; every merge is refused while a loop is active.
